Res. No. 2026-07
      			STATE OF CALIFORNIA
      			COUNTY OF ORANGE 		)   ss:
      			CITY OF HUNTINGTON BEACH   )
   						I, LISA LANE BARNES, the duly elected, qualified City Clerk of the
      			City of Huntington Beach, and ex-officio Clerk of the City Council of said City, do
      			hereby certify that the whole number of members of the City Council of the City of
      			Huntington Beach is seven; that the foregoing resolution was passed and adopted
      			by the affirmative vote of at least a majority of all the members of said City Council
      			at.a Regular meeting thereof held on April 7, 2026 by the following vote:
      			AYES:  	Gruel, Kennedy, McKeon, Burns, Williams
      			NOES:  	None
      			ABSENT:     Twining, Van Der Mark
      			RECUSED:   None
